observation: Star plug, coherent. Iso: a square flange with a deeper square spigot below it, hex granulation engraved into two corners of the flange and two flame cones standing on the other two. Front view: the spigot is the lower block, the flange sits proud above it with a drafted skirt, and both flames rise clear with drafted sides and no downward-facing ledge. Top view: the two flame feet sit wholly inside the flange corners. One solid, nothing floating, no visible intersections.
